description.en: Reveal content once as it enters the viewport with a reduced-motion fallback.

description.zh: 把动画进度绑定到滚动区间，调节起止位置与运动幅度。
description.en: Bind animation progress to a scroll range and tune its start, end, and travel.

description.zh: 让前后景以克制的速度差移动，建立轻量层次感。
description.en: Move foreground and background at restrained relative speeds to create depth.

description.zh: 在页面或视图切换时保持内容连续，并为旧浏览器提供降级。
description.en: Preserve continuity across page or view changes with a safe fallback.

description.zh: 在指针悬停时强化可交互性，同时保持布局稳定。
description.en: Reinforce interactivity on pointer hover while keeping layout stable.

description.zh: 在按下瞬间提供短促缩放和明暗反馈，确认输入已被接收。
description.en: Confirm input immediately with a brief scale and contrast response.

description.zh: 用可取消的进度反馈表达长按确认，降低误触风险。
description.en: Show cancellable progress during hold-to-confirm interactions to reduce mistakes.

description.zh: 在拖拽排序时保持拾取、占位和落点状态清楚。
description.en: Keep pickup, placeholder, and drop states clear while reordering.

description.zh: 让滑动距离映射到位移与透明度，并在阈值前提供阻尼。
description.en: Map swipe distance to travel and opacity with resistance before the threshold.

description.zh: 用一次短促横向摆动提示错误或需要关注的输入。
description.en: Use one brief horizontal shake for errors or inputs that need attention.

description.zh: 从输入坐标扩散轻量波纹，提供明确的触点反馈。
description.en: Expand a restrained ripple from the input coordinate for precise touch feedback.

description.zh: 比较常用缓动曲线和自定义贝塞尔曲线的速度变化。
description.en: Compare common easing curves and custom cubic-bezier velocity profiles.

description.zh: 通过刚度、阻尼、质量和初速度调节真实的弹簧响应。
description.en: Tune a physical spring response with stiffness, damping, mass, and initial velocity.

description.zh: 比较循环方向、次数、暂停和节奏，避免持续动态干扰阅读。
description.en: Compare loop direction, count, pauses, and rhythm while controlling distraction.

description.zh: 让超出容器的信息连续滚动，并在悬停或聚焦时暂停。
description.en: Continuously scroll overflowing content and pause it on hover or focus.

description.zh: 让装饰节点围绕中心缓慢运行，适合低频状态展示。
description.en: Move a decorative node slowly around a center for low-frequency status displays.

description.zh: 用低幅度呼吸或漂浮提示元素仍处于可用、等待或活跃状态。
description.en: Use subtle breathing or floating motion for available, waiting, or active states.

description.zh: 结合模糊、透明度与遮罩柔和地揭示媒体或内容层。
description.en: Reveal media or content layers with coordinated blur, opacity, and masking.

description.zh: 用可拖动分割线比较同一画面的前后状态。
description.en: Compare before and after states of the same visual with a draggable divider.

description.zh: 通过描边偏移逐步绘制图标、路径或解释性连线。
description.en: Draw icons, paths, or explanatory connectors with stroke offset animation.

description.zh: 在长度接近的短文本之间进行平滑替换，保留阅读位置。
description.en: Transition between similarly sized short labels while preserving reading position.

description.zh: 在内容加载期间用低对比扫光表达进行中状态。
description.en: Communicate loading progress with a low-contrast shimmer across placeholders.

description.zh: 使用等宽数字与垂直滚动稳定展示数值变化。
description.en: Show changing values with tabular figures and stable vertical digit movement.

description.zh: 按字符逐步显示短文本，并为辅助技术保留完整内容。
description.en: Reveal short text character by character while preserving complete accessible text.

description.zh: 检查帧率、主线程长任务和掉帧，定位动态卡顿。
description.en: Inspect frame rate, long main-thread tasks, and dropped frames to diagnose jank.

description.zh: 比较合成友好属性、硬件加速提示与布局触发属性的渲染成本。
description.en: Compare compositor-friendly properties, hardware-acceleration hints, and layout-triggering properties.

description.zh: 审核每段动效的目的、出现频率和空间规则，保持一致体验。
description.en: Review the purpose, frequency, and spatial rules of motion for a consistent experience.

description.zh: 调节预备、跟随与形变幅度，理解物理感对反馈的影响。
description.en: Tune anticipation, follow-through, and deformation to understand physical feedback.

description.zh: 通过即时状态、骨架和连续反馈缩短用户感受到的等待。
description.en: Reduce perceived waiting with immediate state changes, skeletons, and continuous feedback.

description.zh: 为移动、缩放、循环和视差提供等价的低动态表达。
description.en: Provide equivalent low-motion treatments for travel, scaling, loops, and parallax.
